name.value: The Old School House Gallery & Arts Centre

description.value: The Old School House Arts Centre is a historic former school building in Qualicum Beach that has been transformed into the mid-Vancouver Island hub for visual and performing arts. It hosts rotating juried exhibitions, art classes ranging from printmaking to watercolour, resident artist studios, and intimate live music concerts. A registered non-profit welcoming visitors of all backgrounds, it is a genuine cultural landmark on a coastal cycling route through central Vancouver Island.

address.value: 122 Fern Road West, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1T2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at theoldschoolhouse.org is fully accessible and confirms the name, address (122 Fern Road West, Qualicum Beach), and phone number matching OSM. The site describes an active, non-profit arts centre with exhibitions, workshops, and live music events, confirming it is open and operating. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields default to null per evidence rules. A name discrepancy was noted: OSM includes 'Gallery &' while the website consistently uses 'The Old School House Arts Centre' without it.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'The Old School House Gallery & Arts Centre' but the website consistently uses 'The Old School House Arts Centre' (omitting 'Gallery &'). The website value may be the current official name.

The about page footer references a 'Public Internet and Computer Usage' policy, hinting at possible public Wi-Fi or computer terminals, but no explicit Wi-Fi availability statement was found; marked null.
Food service (canapés and desserts from Qualicum Beach Café) appears only for ticketed jazz concert events, not as a regular on-site café offering; not counted as café amenity.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established non-profit arts centre in Qualicum Beach on a popular Vancouver Island cycling corridor; a culturally notable attraction worth listing for touring cyclists even though cyclist-specific amenities are unconfirmed.
